verdict.rationale: Zoho Books' own marketing says its built-in Zia AI can "Spot anomalies before they become problems". Zoho MCP lets agents such as Claude connect to Books and "monitor, reason, and act without human input", and a quoted customer credits it with speeding up month-end closures. The anomaly claim is a single marketing line with no detail on how it works, though, and nothing addresses duplicate-transaction detection or ledger-level spend monitoring specifically. Missing for 10: documented duplicate-transaction detection, detail on what Zia's anomaly spotting covers in spend or ledger data, a documented agent workflow that flags anomalies before close, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close

citations.quote: Spot anomalies before they become problems
It enables fully autonomous agents to monitor, reason, and act without human input.
Month-end closures, lead follow-ups, invoice tracking, all reduced from hours to minutes
